messages:
Ana M.: Heads-up ":eyes:" — PulseTech wants to shorten renewal to 9 months, request monthly invoices, and require vendor code + VAT on invoices. They also want to preview the Okta SSO appendix in DocuSign before signing. Redline: https://docsend.example/pulsetech-renewal
Tom B.: Got it. What concession are they asking for? Need numbers to confirm with CFO.
Ana M.: They're asking for 5% off the 9mo pro-rate. Current ARR = $210k -> 9mo = $157,500 -> after 5% = $149,625 -> monthly ~= $16,625.
FinanceBot: Monthly invoices ok. Net45 accepted only with validated PO + vendor code + VAT. Otherwise card/wire. 5% concession approved at AM level if signed this quarter.
Priya R.: Legal: Okta appendix fine as an exhibit. We can attach and surface it in DocuSign pre-sign. We'll add SSO contact attestation field.
Tom B.: Sending customer note: "We can do 9mo with 5% concession; monthly invoices available. Net45 accepted with PO + vendor code + VAT. We'll send DocuSign with Okta appendix attached for preview before signature."
RenewalAssistant: Reminder set: follow up in 48h if PO not received.
Ana M.: Providing PO template to procurement now:
```
PO Number: ________
Purchasing Org: PulseTech Ltd.
Vendor Code: ________
VAT Number: ________
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: Monthly
Payment Terms: Net45 (with PO)
Total Amount: $149,625
Billing Contact: billing@pulsetech.example
```
Tom B.: Customer replied: "Routing PO, vendor code PT-900. Will upload PO PDF to billing@redwood.example today. Please include SSO appendix in DocuSign." :thumbsup:
FinanceBot: Once signed DocuSign + PO PDF with PT-900 received, billing will schedule monthly invoices and attach PO to first invoice.
Priya R.: I'll finalize redline and confirm DocuSign envelope setup. Legal will include the exhibit and the attestation checkbox.
Ana M.: Marking as in-flight. Will update when PO + signed envelope received.
RenewalAssistant: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 48h.
